column2: shot on a smartphone: everything sharp from front to back, bright HDR with lifted shadows, oversharpened edges, punchy colors, a small hard sunstar with green lens ghosts, if the sun is present
shot on a 35mm film compact camera: a candid analog snapshot, coarse, clearly visible film grain, faded film colors, darker corners, a warm halation glow around the sun and bright lights, if present
shot on a full-frame digital camera: crisp fine detail, clean tones, a wide dynamic range with detail in the brightest and darkest areas, natural colors
shot on a medium format camera: exceptionally fine detail, very smooth tonal transitions, rich lifelike midtones, the main subject sharp, the background falling off softly into gentle blur
scan of an instant film photo: a square picture in a cream-white frame with a much wider bottom border, soft detail, low contrast, pastel colors
aerial drone photo from far above, about 50 meters high, looking steeply down: the main subject tiny, the terrain around it spread out below like a map
action camera: the camera very close to the main subject, which looms large, the background small and far away, extreme barrel distortion filling the rectangular frame, the horizon curved into an arc
14mm ultra-wide lens, 114° view: a very wide view, everything in the frame much smaller, far more of the surroundings at every edge, lines stretched and converging near the edges
24mm wide-angle lens, 84° view: a wide view, everything in the frame smaller, much more of the surroundings at the edges, a strong sense of depth
35mm lens, 63° view: a moderately wide view, the main subject together with its surroundings, natural perspective
50mm lens, 47° view: a natural perspective like the human eye, undistorted proportions, near and far in natural relation
85mm lens, 29° view: a narrower view, everything in the frame larger, less of the surroundings, the background enlarged and pulled closer, softly out of focus
135mm telephoto lens, 18° view: a narrow view, everything much larger, only a small slice of the background, strongly enlarged and pulled close behind the main subject, flattened depth
400mm super-telephoto lens, 6° view from very far away: the background hugely enlarged and stacked flat right behind the main subject, distant mountains or buildings, if present, looming huge
macro lens at 1:1: a tiny detail of the main subject, such as the eye of a person, filling the frame, nothing between the lens and the detail, finest textures visible, a paper-thin plane in focus
circular fisheye lens: a round 180° image circle on pure black, nothing outside it, everything inside heavily bulging from the center, straight lines bent into strong curves, the horizon a deep arc
tilt-shift lens with tilted focus: a realistic photo with only a narrow horizontal band in sharp focus, everything above and below it progressively and strongly blurred
shift lens: the camera level, all vertical lines, such as the edges of buildings, if present, perfectly parallel and upright, no converging lines, even when looking up at tall things
anamorphic lens: a widescreen cinematic look, oval out-of-focus highlights, long horizontal blue lens flares from bright lights, if present, slight barrel distortion
f/1.4: razor-thin focus on the main subject only; the background melts into smooth, featureless color areas, foreground things near the camera into soft blurs; bright lights as round glows
f/4: a moderate depth of field, the main subject sharp, things well in front of or behind it gently blurred but recognizable; the sun, if present, with short soft rays
f/11: a deep depth of field, everything sharp from the nearest foreground to the far background; the sun or bright point lights, if present, as crisp starbursts with long rays
a very fast shutter of 1/4000 s: everything that moves, such as hair, fabric, water drops, people or vehicles, if present, frozen crisply in mid-motion, no blur
a slow shutter of about 1/15 s: everything that moves, such as hair, fabric, water, leaves, people or vehicles, if present, smeared into long, clearly visible streaks; static parts sharp

a 5-second exposure of exactly this scene, nothing added: whatever moves, such as hair, fabric or leaves, smeared strongly; water a silky veil, walkers ghosts, vehicles light trails; still parts sharp
ISO 100: a clean, smooth image without any visible noise, the finest detail, rich colors and the widest tonal range
ISO 3200: strong, clearly visible grain and color noise across the whole image, strongest in the shadows, slightly softer detail and muted colors
eye level: the camera at the height of the main subject, looking straight at it, vertical lines upright
a low angle: the camera low, looking up at the main subject, which looms large, the sky or ceiling behind it, vertical lines, if present, converging upward
a high angle: the camera above the main subject, looking down at it, the main subject smaller, the ground behind it
a top-down view from high above, looking straight down: the main subject seen from above like everything around it, no larger than people or things beside it, only ground and tops visible, no horizon
a dutch angle: the camera rolled sideways by about 20 degrees, the whole image clearly tilted, the horizon, if present, and all vertical lines running diagonally
an extreme wide shot: the main subject tiny within a vast view of its surroundings
a wide shot: the whole main subject in the frame with space around it, such as a person from head to toe
a medium shot: the camera closer, about half of the main subject in the frame, such as a person from the waist up, the rest cut off by the frame edge
a close-up: the main subject fills the frame, such as a face with head and shoulders
an extreme close-up: a single small detail of the main subject fills the whole frame, such as the eyes or a hand
